statements.quote: Data Cloud and AI annual recurring revenue over $1.2 billion, up 120% Y/Y
statements.notes: 'over $1.2 billion' recorded as 1.2B (a lower bound). No year is named; it is a point-in-time figure as of the quarter ended 2025-07-31 (Q2 fiscal 2026).
